negative_item_policy: Do not copy legacy penalties. Add only a separately evidenced harmful action with visible policy basis, explicit non-overlap and cross-profile shared semantics; log external acceptance gap until reviewed.
score_uncertainty: If a required fact cannot be safely determined, report JUDGE_ERROR and no total. Unknown is not zero.
equivalence: Accept business-equivalent layouts and formulas. Preserve source-native structure only where explicitly requested. No use of oracle values to choose candidate regions.
pre_rollout_weight_basis: Frozen before any A1 Agent attempt. Historical source-derived lease financing rate is fixed and disclosed to make the native engine verifiable. Downstream what-if usability of both forecasts/valuations is an explicit primary deliverable, allocated35%; current numerical delivery and original basis retain65%. No extra hurdle/cap; legal equivalent formulas accepted.

R005.aggregation: mean(source basis preserved, mean of unchanged response/input facts)

numeric_tolerances.unit_choice: Bound semantic metric determines rate or monetary tolerance; not candidate values
